# eon_backup_posture_control (Resource)

Creates and manages a backup posture control in an Eon project. A backup posture control selects resources via `resource_selector` and defines backup requirements those resources must meet via `rules`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    eon = {
      source = "eon-io/eon"
    }
  }
}

# Example: Backup posture control that applies to all resources and requires cross-region copies
resource "eon_backup_posture_control" "cross_region" {
  name     = "Require Cross-Region Backup"
  severity = "HIGH"

  resource_selector = {
    resource_selection_mode = "ALL"
  }

  rules = {
    cross_region     = true
    number_of_copies = { min_copies = 2 }
  }
}

# Example: Conditional control scoped to production environments
resource "eon_backup_posture_control" "prod_retention" {
  name     = "Production Minimum Retention"
  severity = "MEDIUM"

  resource_selector = {
    resource_selection_mode = "CONDITIONAL"
    expression = {
      environment = {
        operator     = "IN"
        environments = ["PROD"]
      }
    }
  }

  rules = {
    minimum_retention = [
      {
        frequency         = "daily"
        minimum_retention = 30
      },
    ]
    maximum_retention = {
      maximum_retention = 365
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the backup posture control.
- `resource_selector` (Attributes) Selects which resources the control applies to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resource_selector))
- `rules` (Attributes) Backup requirements a resource must satisfy to pass the control. Every rule is optional: a rule you set is evaluated, and one you omit is not. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `severity` (String) Severity assigned to the control and to the violations it raises. Possible values: `HIGH`, `MEDIUM`, `LOW`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) System-generated unique identifier for the backup posture control.

Required:

Optional:
